comparison.position: The component executes Equation7 task-private low-rank projection, Equations10–11 sparse shared/private output composition, Equations12–14 EMA evidence/relative weights/stop-gradient and Equations15–17 request-local MaxSim/KL, with real autograd path checks. Router scores, expert outputs, probed gradients and interest probabilities are explicit tensors; unspecified router/probability heads are not fabricated. The complete Transformer, RMSNorm, attention mask, embeddings, scenario pipeline, expert networks, MoE z-loss, training schedule and deployment are absent. This is not a complete model, formal benchmark or Evolve operator.
comparison.tradeoff: OneTrans-V2 shares causal user context through stage-isolated tokens and transfers centered-logit/sigmoid signals from fine ranking to pre-ranking. LazUnirec addresses retrieval/ranking gradient conflict with task-private LoRA/experts and directional reliability, distilling a request-local softmax distribution into retrieval. Shared context does not mean fully shared parameters, and private parameters do not guarantee orthogonal gradients. The existing MovieLens OneTrans-V2 path is a concept demo, while this batch checks only operators; their proxy capability scores are not comparable.
